# As-is disposition matrix

**Abstraction:** Three stored modes of one constructed breaker. Context retains generation, expiry, counters, callback settings, and separately scoped caller lifetimes. Mode effects are assigned to the phase that commits them. ReadState can combine observation and transition. Admission and report cells for stored Open describe their phase after ObserveExpiry, which runs first under the same lock. A defensive rejection on an internal seam denotes a boundary breach with no public delivery path. Alternate public front ends are projected onto the same machine.

## Guard notes

- G-01 maxRequests default. 0 defaults to 1; nonzero retained. proven in guard-results.txt. gobreaker.go:147.
- G-02 interval default. negative and zero disable; positive retained. proven in guard-results.txt. gobreaker.go:153.
- G-03 timeout default. negative and zero give 60 seconds; positive retained. proven in guard-results.txt. gobreaker.go:159.
- G-04 trip callback default. nil vs configured. proven in guard-results.txt. gobreaker.go:165.
- G-05 classifier default. nil vs configured. proven in guard-results.txt. gobreaker.go:171.
- G-06 admission. Open refuses; HalfOpen below/at/above max; Closed admits. proven in guard-results.txt. gobreaker.go:285.
- G-07 generation. sample after expiry processing; unequal returns. proven in guard-results.txt. gobreaker.go:299.
- G-08 default trip. 5 stays; 6 opens. proven in guard-results.txt. gobreaker.go:193.
- G-09 trial success threshold. after increment, below stays and at/above closes. proven in guard-results.txt. gobreaker.go:316.
- G-10 closed expiry sentinel. zero interval disables; nonzero sets expiry. proven in guard-results.txt. gobreaker.go:370.
- G-11 clock expiry. strict comparison against sampled time; equality waits. not-formalizable in guard-results.txt. gobreaker.go:337.
- G-12 custom trip callback. true opens, false stays; unknown function can fail or never return. not-formalizable in guard-results.txt. gobreaker.go:326.
- G-13 observer configured. nil vs present. proven in guard-results.txt. gobreaker.go:358.
- G-14 setState equality. unchanged target vs different target. proven in guard-results.txt. gobreaker.go:349.
- G-15 classifier outcome and panic. success/failure and non-return outcomes depend on injected code. not-formalizable in guard-results.txt. gobreaker.go:243.
- G-16 panic recovery. nil vs non-nil recovered value. proven in guard-results.txt. gobreaker.go:236.
- G-17 completion dispatch. true success vs false failure. proven in guard-results.txt. gobreaker.go:303.
- G-18 expiry mode partition. Closed and Open and HalfOpen have separate deadline policies. proven in guard-results.txt. gobreaker.go:368.
- G-19 default classification. nil vs nonnil error. proven in guard-results.txt. gobreaker.go:197.
- G-20 admission return. nil vs nonnil error branch, shared by Allow. proven in guard-results.txt. gobreaker.go:230.

HalfOpen below limit and at limit share a mode with different admission guards. A success count is evaluated after increment. Failure in HalfOpen commits Open without first incrementing TotalFailures. Counter writes occur before a documented state reset where applicable. Call entries and callback outcomes are distinct phases, and a callback can interrupt its caller before it receives a result.
